name: Tunimus
slug: Killed by Grixto after Grixto grew stronger on stolen Al Kurin.
description: Tunimus was killed by Grixto after Grixto amplified his power with stolen Al Kurin. The DM alluded to a second victim, possibly Tunimus's right hand, whose name he could not recall. Their group then met its end at the hands of Elrus and Araden.
